name: nexoffice
description: AI-native office suite (docs, sheets, slides, pdf)

scripts.test: npm run test -w @nexoffice/i18n && npm run test -w @nexoffice/electron-utils && npm run test -w @nexoffice/font-metrics && npm run test -w @nexoffice/docx-engine && npm run test -w @nexoffice/pdf2docx && npm run test -w @nexoffice/file-parse && npm run test -w @nexoffice/pptx-engine && npm run test -w @nexoffice/pptx-render && npm run test -w @nexoffice/ai-search && npm run test -w @nexoffice/project-store && npm run test -w @nexoffice/capabilities && npm run test -w @nexoffice/mcp && npm run test -w @nexoffice/docs && npm run test -w @nexoffice/sheets && npm run test -w @nexoffice/shell && npm run test -w @nexoffice/slides && npm run test -w @nexoffice/pdf && npm run test -w @nexoffice/markdown
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @nexoffice/i18n && npm run typecheck -w @nexoffice/electron-utils && npm run typecheck -w @nexoffice/font-metrics && npm run typecheck -w @nexoffice/docx-engine && npm run typecheck -w @nexoffice/pdf2docx && npm run typecheck -w @nexoffice/file-parse && npm run typecheck -w @nexoffice/pptx-engine && npm run typecheck -w @nexoffice/pptx-render && npm run typecheck -w @nexoffice/ai-search && npm run typecheck -w @nexoffice/project-store && npm run typecheck -w @nexoffice/capabilities && npm run typecheck -w @nexoffice/mcp && npm run typecheck -w @nexoffice/ui && npm run typecheck -w @nexoffice/docs && npm run typecheck -w @nexoffice/sheets && npm run typecheck -w @nexoffice/shell && npm run typecheck -w @nexoffice/slides && npm run typecheck -w @nexoffice/pdf && npm run typecheck -w @nexoffice/markdown
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n docs,sheets,slides,pdf,markdown,shell -c blue,green,yellow,red,cyan,magenta "npm run dev:renderer -w @nexoffice/docs" "npm run dev:renderer -w @nexoffice/sheets" "npm run dev:renderer -w @nexoffice/slides" "npm run dev:renderer -w @nexoffice/pdf" "npm run dev:renderer -w @nexoffice/markdown" "DOCS_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5173 SHEETS_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5174 SLIDES_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5175 PDF_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5176 MARKDOWN_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5177 npm run dev -w @nexoffice/shell"
scripts.build:all: npm run build -w @nexoffice/docs && npm run build -w @nexoffice/sheets && npm run build -w @nexoffice/slides && npm run build -w @nexoffice/pdf && npm run build -w @nexoffice/markdown && npm run build -w @nexoffice/mcp && npm run build -w @nexoffice/shell
scripts.dist:mac: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run native:build:universal -w @nexoffice/sheets && npm run dist:mac -w @nexoffice/shell
scripts.dist:win: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run dist:win -w @nexoffice/shell
scripts.dist:linux: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run dist:linux -w @nexoffice/shell
